guardrail: This proposal is review-only. It does NOT authorize live capital, does NOT enable live trading, and does NOT set LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED=true. Any future live-enablement implementation requires a separately defined, explicitly human-approved campaign with its own gates/checkpoints and zero ambiguity.

PAPER_RUNBOOK_DRILL_AND_GO_NO_GO.recommendation: GO for continued paper operations / NO-GO for live capital enablement

paper_gates_summary.go_no_go_recommendation: GO for continued paper operations / NO-GO for live capital enablement

residual_risks.description: Indexed paper campaign JSON files expose canonical pass/fail in summary.all_critical_passed/failed; some top-level/report fields may be null. Ops/proposal consumers must read summary/checkpoint evidence, not ad-hoc top-level fields.
residual_risks.mitigation: Bind future gates to summary.* and campaign checkpoints; add schema assertion in any live-enablement preflight.

residual_risks.description: Pre-existing scoped mypy debt: 40 errors in 13 files under src/monitoring src/telemetry src/validation (phase74/79/80 hardening), unchanged in this review campaign.
residual_risks.mitigation: Do not mass-refactor phase79/80/110 mega-files. Require scoped mypy no-new-errors for touched paths in any future implementation campaign; schedule dedicated debt reduction if touching those modules.

residual_risks.description: Paper evidence validates controlled flows; real venue behavior (partial fills, rejects, rate limits, maintenance windows, margin/option-specific semantics, stale market data) can differ under live conditions.
residual_risks.mitigation: Venue-scoped, limit-capped canary with paper-parity reconciliation; explicit venue credential verification; maintenance/rate-limit handling; manual operator supervision during initial live window.

residual_risks.description: Live enablement would require venue API credentials with trading permissions. Secrets leakage or over-privileged keys can cause unauthorized/irreversible capital loss.
residual_risks.mitigation: Least-privilege keys (trade-only as needed, no withdrawal where possible); separate paper/live credentials; secrets only in approved secret store/env injection; never committed; rotation/revocation plan; IP allowlists where supported.

residual_risks.description: Backtest/paper slippage assumptions may understate live slippage, spread widening, or liquidity gaps in stressed markets.
residual_risks.mitigation: Conservative live size caps; slippage/impact limits; circuit breakers; compare realized fills vs expected; pause on anomalous execution quality.

residual_risks.description: Orderflow/signal behavior may drift with regime changes, venue microstructure changes, or data quality degradation.
residual_risks.mitigation: Continuous CV/monitoring cadence; drift and data-quality gates; shadow/canary comparison before scaling; operator review of attribution and reconciliation deltas.

residual_risks.description: Automated gates are necessary but insufficient. Live enablement without explicit human approval and operator readiness increases operational risk.
residual_risks.mitigation: Mandatory human-approval checklist; named approver; defined rollback owner; runbook rehearsal; no automated live-enabling default.

required_operator_controls.mode_control: LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED must remain false/default-off. Any future campaign must use an explicit, auditable, reversible enablement mechanism scoped to approved venue/symbol/limits; no production default may enable live trading.
limits: Max notional per order, per symbol, per venue, and per day
Max open positions/contracts and max net/gross delta exposure
Max order rate and max cancel/replace rate
Max reconciliation mismatch tolerance before halt

triggers: Unexpected venue/API error burst or auth anomaly
kill_switch.behavior: Halt new order submission; preserve audit trail; reconcile positions/orders; require explicit operator ack and controlled restart procedure.

required_operator_controls.circuit_breakers: Retain/exercise circuit breakers as proven in incident drill; verify failure-path behavior per venue adapter before any approved live canary.
monitoring: Reconciliation freshness SLO target >= 0.99 with real measurements
PnL attribution (directional vs hedge) and unexpected drift
Data quality, latency, and venue connectivity
Risk limit utilization and kill-switch state
required_operator_controls.runbook_and_drills: Use docs/PAPER_RUNBOOK.md as baseline. Require pre-live rehearsal of incident ack, kill-switch, reconciliation mismatch handling, and rollback in the approved environment before capital exposure.

credential_boundaries.storage: Approved secret manager / CI/CD protected secrets / operator-controlled env injection only. No secrets in repo, logs, artifacts, or chat transcripts.
credential_boundaries.separation: Paper and live credentials must be distinct. Paper keys must not have live withdrawal/trade authority where avoidable; live keys must be scoped narrowly.
credential_boundaries.least_privilege: Enable only required permissions (read + trade as needed). Disable withdrawal if venue supports. Prefer subaccounts/portfolio isolation for canary.
credential_boundaries.rotation_and_revocation: Document key rotation, emergency revocation, and post-incident credential invalidation steps before any live campaign.
credential_boundaries.verification: Credential verification is allowed only in an explicitly approved, non-enabling preflight that proves auth/permissions without placing unintended capital-risk orders.

monitoring_and_reconciliation_cadence.continuous_validation: Run strict CV/monitoring on defined cadence (at minimum before/after canary changes and on schedule) with fresh artifacts.
monitoring_and_reconciliation_cadence.reconciliation: Position/order/balance reconciliation at startup, on schedule, and before/after critical actions. Critical mismatches auto-halt and require operator ack.
monitoring_and_reconciliation_cadence.slo: Reconciliation freshness SLO target_gte 0.99 must be met with measurements; no synthetic pass.
monitoring_and_reconciliation_cadence.review: Operator review of alerts, attribution, execution quality, and risk utilization during any approved live window.

rollback_and_disable_procedure.immediate_disable: Set/confirm live enablement off; trigger kill-switch; stop new order submission; cancel open orders where safe per venue policy.
rollback_and_disable_procedure.reconcile: Capture final positions/orders/fills/balances; reconcile against venue; document discrepancies.
rollback_and_disable_procedure.credential_response: Revoke/rotate credentials if compromise or anomalous activity suspected.
rollback_and_disable_procedure.evidence: Write timestamped incident/rollback artifact under research_state with actions, timestamps, reconciled state, and approver/operator identity.
rollback_and_disable_procedure.restart_gate: No restart of live capital flow without explicit human approval, root-cause review, and passing preflight gates.

human_approval_checklist.item: Named human approver reviewed this proposal and all cited prerequisite artifacts.
Residual risks (R1-R7) accepted or mitigated with documented controls.
Venue/symbol scope, notional/position/delta/drawdown/rate/slippage limits, and canary size approved.
Kill-switch, circuit-breaker, reconciliation-halt, and operator escalation paths tested/rehearsed for the approved scope.
Live credentials provisioned with least privilege and paper/live separation; secrets stored outside repo; rotation/revocation plan confirmed.
Rollback/disable procedure reviewed; rollback owner assigned; evidence capture path confirmed.

Explicit decision recorded: this review-only proposal does NOT enable live trading. LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED must remain false until a separately defined, explicitly approved live-enablement campaign completes.

constraints: Only proceed if explicit human approval is recorded in artifacts for all required checklist items.
Define narrow, venue-scoped, limit-capped live-enablement gates with kill-switch drills, credential verification, and rollback proof.
No implementation before approval; live remains disabled until that campaign passes.
